findings.title: GraphiQL IDE enabled unconditionally in all environments
findings.exploit_path: Deploy with NODE_ENV=production → unauthenticated attacker opens GET/POST /graphql GraphiQL UI → explores schema, runs queries (public category queries today; future mutations inherit exposure).
findings.disprover_notes: No NODE_ENV guard, introspection policy, or auth wrapper around GraphiQL in GraphQLModule config. Depth limit does not restrict IDE access.
findings.remediation: Set `graphiql: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` (or false in production). Disable introspection in production via Apollo plugins. Document ops requirement in docs/threat-model.md.

findings.title: Unauthenticated job enqueue on example background-jobs endpoint
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-306 / OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures
findings.exploit_path: When BACKGROUND_JOBS_ENABLED loads ExampleJobsModule → POST /example/jobs/echo without Authorization → enqueues arbitrary payloads (dedupeKey optional) → worker/Postgres/BullMQ load and queue flooding.
findings.disprover_notes: @Public() bypasses global JwtAuthGuard. Global IP rate limit (10/min) is weak abuse control, not authentication. Example module ships in default app.module imports.
findings.remediation: Remove @Public() or guard with JwtAuthGuard + role; gate ExampleJobsModule behind NODE_ENV=development or explicit EXAMPLE_ROUTES_ENABLED=false in production. Add integration test asserting 401 without token in production profile.

findings.title: Authorization role taken from JWT claim without live DB reconciliation
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-613 / OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control
findings.exploit_path: User receives JWT with role=admin → operator demotes user in MongoDB → user retains admin API/WebSocket privileges until access token TTL expires and refresh occurs (role re-read only on refresh/login in AuthService).
findings.disprover_notes: isRevoked checks session JTI only, not role. FeatureFlagPermissionsGuard reads request.user.role from JWT-derived context.
findings.remediation: On each request (or per sensitive route), load role from DB or include role version in JWT and invalidate on change. Minimum: reload role in AccessTokenAuthenticator.userFromVerifiedPayload via User model.

findings.title: HTTP CORS allows wildcard origins with credentials when ALLOWED_ORIGINS unset
findings.exploit_path: Production deployment with empty ALLOWED_ORIGINS → enableCors origin resolves to '*' with credentials:true → misconfiguration; browser may block some cases but non-browser clients and future SPA origins may be overly permissive depending on @fastify/cors reflection behavior.
findings.disprover_notes: WebSocket layer throws if production ALLOWED_ORIGINS empty (assertWebSocketProductionOrigins), but HTTP CORS in main.ts has no parallel guard. Browsers often reject Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* with credentials, reducing cookie-based CSRF from random origins but not fixing API misconfiguration.
findings.remediation: Mirror websocket production check: fail fast at bootstrap if NODE_ENV=production and ALLOWED_ORIGINS missing/empty. Use explicit origin callback, never '*' with credentials.

findings.title: Conformance harness exposes public loopback HTTP proxy on non-production stacks
findings.exploit_path: CONFORMANCE_HARNESS_ENABLED=true on staging (allowed by validateEnv) → unauthenticated POST /conformance/http-client with targetUrl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/... → server-side GET to loopback services (metadata, admin panels) when HTTP client permits private URLs.
findings.disprover_notes: Production blocks harness via validateEnv. assertLoopbackTargetUrl limits host to localhost/127.0.0.1. Outbound call still subject to HttpClient SSRF unless HTTP_CLIENT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=true (common in test harness docs). Exploit requires harness enabled and reachable staging URL.
findings.remediation: Bind conformance controllers to 127.0.0.1-only middleware, require mTLS/admin token, or compile out ConformanceModule outside test profiles. Document forbidden pairing with HTTP_CLIENT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS on internet-facing hosts.

findings.title: Detailed health checks publicly expose infrastructure state
findings.exploit_path: GET /health or /health/ready without auth → returns Mongo/Redis/Postgres/disk/memory/feature-flag status → attacker maps dependencies and failure modes.
findings.disprover_notes: Intentional for ALB (SkipRateLimit, SkipCountryAccess). Risk depends on edge network policy (internal-only ALB vs public). /health/live is minimal.
findings.remediation: Split public liveness from authenticated or internal-network readiness. Restrict detailed checks via security group or separate admin port.

findings.title: Login/refresh returns bearer access token in JSON body
findings.exploit_path: XSS on same site reads login JSON and exfiltrates accessToken.
findings.disprover_notes: Dual cookie (httpOnly) + body supports non-browser API clients. Exploit requires separate XSS; cookies are httpOnly/sameSite strict. Documented boilerplate pattern, not standalone vuln.
findings.remediation: Optional: omit accessToken from body when Accept indicates browser client; keep body for mobile only.

findings.title: Auth endpoints lack dedicated brute-force rate limits
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-307 / OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures
findings.exploit_path: Credential stuffing against POST /auth/login at global 10 req/min/IP.
findings.disprover_notes: Global fixed-window IP limit applies to login. PasswordHashBulkhead adds CPU cost. Edge rate limiting documented in architecture.md as deployment concern.
findings.remediation: Add stricter auth-specific rate limit metadata on login/register if edge limits absent.

findings.title: GraphQL category IDOR via Mongo query
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-639 / OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control
findings.exploit_path: Query category(id) for other tenants' data.
findings.disprover_notes: In-memory demo data only; no tenant model or persistence. Public read is intentional boilerplate sample.
findings.remediation: N/A until real multi-tenant category store is added.

findings.title: HTTP client private URL bypass via env flag
findings.disprover_notes: Flag is process env operator-controlled, not user input. Default path uses assertPublicHttpUrl. Misconfiguration is ops risk, not remote exploit without existing SSRF vector.
findings.remediation: Document in threat model; refuse true in production validateEnv if desired.

findings.title: JWT in WebSocket query string
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-598 / OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures
findings.exploit_path: Token in ?token= leaks via logs and Referer.
findings.disprover_notes: allowQueryToken defaults false in parseWebSocketConfig. Query path only when WEBSOCKET_ALLOW_QUERY_TOKEN=true (operator choice).
findings.remediation: Keep default false; warn in docs when enabling.

findings.title: Unrestricted file upload content execution
findings.exploit_path: Upload malware; server stores and serves executable.
findings.disprover_notes: Endpoint JWT-protected. Response returns metadata only; buffers discarded after validation. Optional ClamAV scan via UPLOAD_VIRUS_SCAN. No static file serving of uploads in controller.
findings.remediation: Ensure virus scan enabled in production uploads feature doc.
